About Sine Nexu

HomePickerAboutSourcesGitHub ↗

Sine Nexu is a free, offline emergency library — survival, medical, repair, food and reference knowledge, plus an offline AI, on a drive that works with no internet and no power grid behind it.

Our mission

To help people when it matters most: when disaster strikes and the power or the internet is gone, and for people in remote parts of the world who have little or no access to the internet. Everyone should be able to hold the essentials — how to stay safe, treat an injury, grow food, repair things, and find their way — on a drive that keeps working offline, anywhere.

Code of conduct

Be kind and assume good faith. Everyone is welcome here, and testing and bug reports count just as much as code. We don't tolerate harassment, discrimination, or hostility of any kind. Keep discussion focused on the work, and help newcomers get started — we were all new once.
